description:
List the Nekoweb sites you follow, newest updates first, with each one's title, link, screenshot and the day it was last updated.

Requires the optional session token (NEKOWEB_SESSION_TOKEN). If it isn't set, this tool returns setup steps to pass on to the user.

Without 'page', every page is fetched (up to 20 pages). For the posts those sites published, use nekoweb_get_feed.

Nekoweb leaves out followed sites whose owners hid them from Explore, so a site missing here may still be followed. nekoweb_follow_site checks a single site reliably.

Examples:
  - "Which sites I follow updated recently?" -> {}
  - "Show the second page of sites I follow" -> { page: 2 }

page.description: Fetch only this page. Omit to fetch them all.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for structured data

name: nekoweb_list_following
title: List followed sites
